name: Beronia Aredo
found: The smoke-sheds at Carnaxe, feeding the juniper fires.
appearance: Small, smoke-darkened, a ring of keys at her waist.
and_yet: Hands white with salt to the wrist.
sayings: My mother's cure. My daughter's cure. Not yours.
wants: The cure kept in the family.
oddly_also: Has never written the cure down.
